description: This PHP class defines the EmailNotification entity for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_email_notification'. It includes properties such as id, name, enabled status, and related EmailSubscriber entities, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Represents an email notification configuration within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_email_notification'. It handles notification properties like ID, name, status, and associated email subscribers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the email notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the email notification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email notification.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the email notification is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the email notification.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribers
methods.description: Returns the list of email subscribers associated with this notification.
